claims: As of April 19, 2026, Dexter Lawrence is 28 years old.
Dexter Lawrence was born on November 12, 1997.
Dexter Lawrence is a defensive tackle for the New York Giants.
Dexter Lawrence has recently been reported to be traded to the Bengals.
Dexter Lawrence's position is Nose Tackle / Defensive Tackle.
Dexter Lawrence has earned Pro Bowl honors for three consecutive seasons (2022–2024)
